senses.gloss: f. (contr. of שחלד, v. חָלַד; cmp. שודא a. שוחדא) a mass of a burnt or decayed body distinguishable in shape and outlines.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 27b">Nidd. 27ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>מת שנשרף ושִׁלְדּוֹ קיימת</he> if a corpse has been burnt, and its remains have retained the shape of the body.
<cite ref="Niddah 56a:21">Nidd. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>שרץ שיבש  ושלדו וכ׳</he> a creeping thing that is dried up, but whose shape is still discernible; a. e.—Pl. <he>שְׁלָדוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:6">Lam. R. to IV, 17</cite> <he>רמז הקב״ה לשַׁלְדּוֹתֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> the Lord motioned to their (the drowned Egyptians’) remains, and they came up floating &c.; <he>מה טיבן של ש׳ הללו</he> what is the nature of these skeletons?
